name: Atlantis  (STS-117)
about: Atlantis  (STS-117) (2007-024A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2007 Jun  8. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2007 Jun 11), held fixed
docked to A06140; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
